outcome.answer: Yes — several papers fit this topic. The closest is [2], which explicitly combines multimodal patient evidence with biomedical knowledge graphs for clinical LLMs and makes the links retrievable, traceable, and testable. [1] also fits, studying how to integrate biomedical knowledge graphs into LLMs for clinical diagnosis and finding that KG-judgment training can improve reasoning. [9] is related too, comparing continual pretraining on a biomedical knowledge graph with GraphRAG for language models, but it is less specifically about clinical LLMs.
